$comment: Read by tooling/validate-duplicates.mjs (pnpm run duplicates:audit). minTokens is the smallest copy that counts. `allowed` holds the pairs of files copied on purpose, each with its reason.

allowed.reason: Two treemaps lay a rectangle out the same way: absolute, clipped, a name over a figure. A global class for it would put a treemap-only rule in the stylesheet of every panel, and the two tiles differ in everything else (one is a button that opens a level, the other a static figure coloured by a comparison).
